sector: Boutique residential real estate brokerage specialising in architect-designed listings, residential property in Marin County.
founded_place_size: Founded 2012, Marin County, California. Six agents led by the principal, working a small book of high-value listings.
about: Cedarline and Vale is a six-agent brokerage in Marin that takes on architect-designed and materially serious homes. We present listings the way the architecture asks to be seen: quietly, accurately, and next to whatever three other agents are showing. Our credibility rests on buyers and vendors trusting that the pictures are the house.
audience: Buyers aged 40 to 60 with household incomes above 400 thousand who read light and material as proxies for build quality, and vendors of design-led homes. They view our listings alongside three competing agents and notice anything that looks retouched.
price_positioning: High-value residential, flagship listings from the low millions up. Positioned above volume agencies and apart from developer marketing, on restraint and accuracy rather than gloss.

typography: Cedarline and Vale works from the brochure. Step 01 is the address in Tobias Light at 28 pt on 30 pt with tracking of minus 8 units, stacked flush left with the street number alone on the first line and the street name directly beneath at the same size, unpunctuated and never italic. Step 02 is the standfirst, also Tobias Light, at 13 pt on 17 pt with tracking of minus 2 units. Step 03 is body in Neue Haas Grotesk Text 55 Roman at 9.5 pt on 14 pt, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04 is the spec table and price in the same grotesque at 8 pt on 11 pt with tracking of plus 8 units and tabular lining figures. On screen the room post address runs 56 px and the enquiry line 24 px. A price is never set in Tobias.
voice: Cool, restrained and true. We describe what is there and let the room speak. No superlatives, no cosiness, nothing that sounds sold. Example line: 'Glass on three sides, the bay through the living room, the oaks off the kitchen.'
brand_assets_status: There is no working design source for the office window cards. Only the flat file the printer sent to press last year survives, and she has retired, so any change means rebuilding from that file. The feature sheet and portal module are expected to be handed back as editable documents because prices move.
values: Accuracy over flattery: cool, restrained and honest, and nothing that reads as retouched.

type_system.signature_move: Every address is stacked in Tobias Light, the street number alone above the street name at the same size, flush left, unpunctuated and never italic.
rules: Never set a price in Tobias.
Prices and spec tables stay in Neue Haas Grotesk Text 55 Roman with tabular lining figures.
The address is always stacked, the number alone above the street name, both at the same size, flush left.
The address is never set in italic.
No superlatives, no cosiness and nothing that sounds sold.

palette_rules.distribution: Plaster White is the only ground behind type, on every page, panel and margin; type never sits directly on a photograph. Type is Deep Charcoal or Marin Slate on Plaster White and nothing else: the address in Deep Charcoal and body text in Marin Slate, as on windowcard_2025_print.pdf; headings, prices, the enquiry line and fine print in either. Bay Grey is for hairline rules and dividers only; Quiet Sage and Warm Stone are small accents only. Bay Grey, Quiet Sage and Warm Stone together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area and are never a ground, a panel or a type colour.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, no type carries a drop shadow or glow, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: type sits on a solid Plaster White block beside or over the photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No gold, brass, bronze or other metallic colour or effect on any type, panel, rule, button or icon, and no black-and-gold treatment: the office rules out developer gold-and-black. No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected, neutral colour and are never recoloured toward the palette. Cool does not mean blue: plaster whites stay neutral, blacks keep their detail, grass keeps its own green, and every sky and window view is the one captured in its frame, never dropped in. The colour prohibitions govern the design, not the photographs: the teak cladding and door of room_12.jpg and the steel range and tap of room_02.jpg stay as shot.
